page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; one block of text in full width; a dedication signature block centred; the word IDEM in capitals; a woodcut ornament below. No margin notes.

main_text.p: cordiam: tibique, vir nobilissime, secundùm Deum, Regis Optimi gratiam & voluntatem omniúmque magnæ Britanniæ ordinum studia ex animo optamus. Vale in Domino. Qui tibi in hac peregrinatione, àte per Gallias & Germanias suscepta, sit dux & lux, per Iesum Christum D.N. Amen. Geneuæ Calend. Martijs An. cIↄ. Iↄc.x.
main_text.head: Tuæ Nobilitati Amplissimæ dedititissimus ANTONIVS FAYVS.
IDEM

page.notes: The ornament is a woodcut diamond-shaped fleuron, not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present and omitted. The dedication line "dedititissimus" is printed as shown on the scan (likely dedicatissimus or dedititissimus; read as printed). The date reads "An.cIↄ. Iↄc.x." i.e. MDCX.
